title: Organization limits
eyebrow: Outer limits for every course in this workspace
notice: These limits sit above every course. A course, a learner's own terms, a chapter or an episode can only be stricter, never looser. Changes apply to new enrollments only; learners already enrolled keep the terms they started with.
end.hint: No enrollment runs past this date. Leave empty for no organization end date.
days.hint: Counted from the day a learner enrolls. Leave empty for no limit.
zone.hint: For example Europe/London. Calendar days are counted in this zone.
blankNoLimit: Leave empty for no organization limit.
work.additionalMinutes: Most extra planned minutes per learner
access: After a course ends, learners can
access.closed: No longer open the course material
extensions: Courses may offer extensions (when off, no course in this workspace can offer extra time or work)
preview: Check the effect on every course
impact: Effect on a learner enrolling today
impact.none: This workspace has no course with a release yet.
impact.more: Only the first 50 courses are checked here.
issue.LOOSER_CHILD_DEADLINE: This course's own end date is later, so the organization's limit will apply to its learners.
issue.DEADLINE_ALREADY_REACHED: A deadline that applies to this course has already passed: no learner could finish its required path. Choose a later date.
issue.TIME_ENVELOPE_TOO_SMALL: The course's required work does not fit before the earliest deadline at its declared study pace.
issue.TIME_FIT_UNCHECKED: This course declares no study pace, so only dates were checked.
issue.other: This course's policy needs a look under these limits; open its policy page for details.
savedMessage: Saved. New enrollments in every course start with these limits; current learners are unchanged.
